context:
Goal: filing your rulings never waits on a reviewer for no gain.
Problem (rule): docs-only-prs-skip-review skips review for a PR that 'touches no rule', but a record that files your ruling may count as touching one, and degen's own merge rule asks a reviewer for every lane, so degen records PRs 370 and 378 waited.
Based on (ruling): docs-only-prs-skip-review (owner, 2026-09-26): a PR that changes only prose or docs, and touches no rule, guard, check or product code, gets no reviewer pass. Asked again only because it does not say whether a record that files one of your rulings counts as touching a rule.
Based on (incident): degen PRs 370 and 378 (degen page item 83).
Departs from: docs-only-prs-skip-review, unclear on ruling records — states when one counts as docs only.

options.gain: Ruling records merge on green; a record that changes a rule still gets a reviewer.
options.how: A record that files your ruling counts as docs only when it changes no rule text, guard, check or code. A repo rule may still ask for a reviewer.
options.label: Docs only unless it changes rule text
options.lose: A misfiled ruling in a record merges unread.

options.gain: Every filed ruling is checked against your words.
options.how: Each ruling record gets a fix-check-size read that compares the filed text with your quote.
options.label: A short read of the quote
options.lose: Each ruling record waits on one more read.

ref: step late-review-fixes; lane session_013NEJL2mkqxZo8g998PyeoS report, branch late-review-fixes head 93af114c; degen page item 83
title: Does a record that files one of your rulings count as docs only, and skip review?
why: The record only files your words; rule text, guards and code still get review.
